scope: Portable aggregate evidence, not a replacement producer/READY manifest
method: B compute-only; post-full-schema-hash projection; MEMORY_AND_DISK/count/oracle/1warmup outside timer
workload: E1 purchase/category revenue-count v1; no join

definitions.std_s: sample standard deviation, n=3; no runs removed
definitions.speedup: T(100%)/T(f); different data sizes, NOT parallel speedup
definitions.normalized_throughput: (N(f)/N(1%))/(T(f)/T(1%)); fixed-resource data scaling, NOT strong-scaling efficiency
definitions.memory_bytes_spilled: cumulative deserialized spill estimate; not peak RAM
